user.title: Sign in to your Decathlon account
user.description:
1. [Open the Decathlon sign-in page]({login_url}) (new tab) and sign in (e-mail + code, or Apple/Google).
2. At the end, a **"Whoops! Looks like something went wrong"** page is shown: this is expected.
3. Copy the **full address** of that page (`{whoops_url}`) and paste it below, quickly (the code expires fast).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign-in required again
reauth_confirm.description:
The session of the account **{account}** expired.

1. [Open the Decathlon sign-in page]({login_url}) (new tab) and sign in (e-mail + code, or Apple/Google).
2. At the end, a **"Whoops! Looks like something went wrong"** page is shown: this is expected.
3. Copy the **full address** of that page (`{whoops_url}`) and paste it below, quickly (the code expires fast).

error.invalid_url: Invalid address or expired code. A new sign-in link was generated: start again with it.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Geocover servers.

abort.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Geocover servers.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different account than the configured one.

auth_failed.message: The Decathlon session expired: please sign in again.

update_failed.message: Error communicating with the Geocover servers: {error}

bike_stolen.title: {bike} is reported stolen
bike_stolen.description: {bike} is reported stolen in the Decathlon Geocover app. This message disappears when the report is cancelled in the app.

no_connection.title: {bike} has not connected for {days} days
no_connection.description: The GPS tracker of {bike} has not connected to the Geocover servers for {days} days: its position is out of date. The tracker may be out of battery or out of network coverage. Ride the bike or charge it to wake the tracker up.

tracker_battery_low.title: Low GPS tracker battery on {bike}
tracker_battery_low.description: The GPS tracker of {bike} is at {level} %. It has its own battery, charged with the bike's battery: charge the bike to keep the bike tracked.
